cluster: kind v0.33.0, Kubernetes v1.37.0, 1 control plane + 2 workers, Docker Desktop on Windows 11
chart: deploy/helm/tether-relay, values deploy/kind/values-kind.yaml (hbbs x2, hbbr x3, proxy x2, api x1)
harness: relay-harness (vendor/rustdesk-server/src/bin/relay-harness.rs) as a pod: host registered at every hbbs over WebSocket, viewer PunchHoleRequest -> RelayResponse -> both pair at the hbbr URL hbbs hands out; 1 KiB frames every 20 ms host->viewer; reconnect = new punch on any relay drop or 1 s of silence; WS ping liveness 2.5 s on registrations
gap_definition: time between the last frame on the old relay connection and the first frame on the new one, measured at the viewer (includes detection)

a1.description: hbbr rolling restart (kubectl rollout restart sts/tether-relay-hbbr) during churn: 6 workers x back-to-back 30 s sessions, 3 hbbr pods, drainSeconds 90

a2.description: hbbs rolling restart (kubectl rollout restart sts/tether-relay-hbbs) during churn: 6 workers x 20 s sessions; hosts registered with both hbbs pods

a3.description: proxy (Caddy) rolling update during 6 live sessions: WebSockets through old proxy pods are cut and re-paired

b1.description: kubectl delete pod tether-relay-hbbr-1 --grace-period=0 --force while it carries live streams

b2.description: kubectl delete pod tether-relay-hbbr-2 --grace-period=15 (shorter than the drain): pod goes not-ready, streams continue until the kill at 15 s, then re-pair

b3a.description: docker pause of the worker node holding hbbr-0, hbbr-1 and hbbs-0 (silent node death), proxy pods on the surviving node; detection by 1 s frame silence

b3.description: same node freeze, but one of the two proxy pods is on the frozen node: kube-proxy keeps its endpoint until the node is NotReady (~40 s in kind), so ~half of new connections hang
